extensionDescription.message: Suggests emoji reactions for Slack messages, including your workspace's custom emoji.
extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store and extensions page.

rowLabel.description: Heading of the suggestion row in Slack's emoji picker.

rowDefaultLabel.description: Fallback heading of the suggestion row, if a site adapter defines none.

rowNoMatch.description: Shown in the suggestion row when nothing scored high enough.

rowClickToOpenSettings.description: Suggestion row status line: an error, followed by a link to open the extension's settings.

rowMatchedSuffix.description: Appended to a suggestion's tooltip when its name was mentioned in the message.

rowNameMatchLabel.description: Appended to a suggestion button's aria-label when its name was mentioned in the message.

errLoadFailed.description: Shown when the service worker's shared scripts failed to load.

errNoApiKey.description: Error when ranking is requested without an API key configured.

errWorkspaceUnknown.message: Could not tell which workspace this is.
errWorkspaceUnknown.description: Error when a workspace id is required but missing.

errNoSlackTab.message: No Slack tab was found. Open Slack and try again.
errNoSlackTab.description: Error when a full custom-emoji harvest is requested with no open Slack tab.

errHarvestTimeout.message: The harvest did not finish in time. Please try again.
errHarvestTimeout.description: Error when a custom-emoji harvest times out.

errReloadSlackTab.description: Error when the Slack tab did not answer as expected.

errHarvestFailed.message: Could not collect the custom emoji.
errHarvestFailed.description: Error when a custom-emoji harvest fails for an unspecified reason.

errKeyEmpty.description: Error when saving an empty API key.

errNoResponse.message: The extension did not respond. Please reload.
errNoResponse.description: Error when the content script gets no response from the service worker.

errNoCustomEmojiSupport.message: This site does not support collecting custom emoji.
errNoCustomEmojiSupport.description: Error when the current site's adapter has no harvesting support.

errHarvestGenericFailed.description: Fallback error when a custom-emoji harvest throws with no message.

errHarvestNoButton.message: Could not find the button that opens the emoji picker.
errHarvestNoButton.description: Error during a custom-emoji harvest when the composer's emoji button is missing.

errHarvestPickerNotOpen.message: The emoji picker did not open.
errHarvestPickerNotOpen.description: Error during a custom-emoji harvest when the picker never appears.

errHarvestNoCustomTab.message: Could not find the custom emoji tab.
errHarvestNoCustomTab.description: Error during a custom-emoji harvest when the picker has no custom-emoji tab.

errInvalidApiKey.message: The API key is not correct. Check it in the extension's settings.
errInvalidApiKey.description: Error when the ranking provider rejects the API key.

errBadRequest.message: The question format was rejected by the API (422): $1
errBadRequest.description: Error when the ranking provider returns a 422 response.

errRateLimited.message: Hit a rate limit. Please wait a bit and try again.
errRateLimited.description: Error when the ranking provider returns a 429 response.

errServerBusy.message: TypeSafe is busy right now. Please wait a bit and try again.
errServerBusy.description: Error when the ranking provider returns a 529 response.

errConnectionFailed.description: Error when the request to the ranking provider fails outright.

errGeneric.description: Fallback error for an unrecognized status code from the ranking provider.

errCandidatesEmpty.description: Error when parsing an empty emoji candidate list.

errTooManyCandidates.message: There are $1 candidates. The maximum is $2 per request.
errTooManyCandidates.description: Error when the emoji candidate list is too long.

errLineUnreadable.message: Line $1 could not be read. Please write it as `:shortcode: description`: $2
errLineUnreadable.description: Error when a candidate list line does not match the expected format.

errDuplicateShortcode.description: Error when a candidate list has the same shortcode twice.

errStandardCandidates.description: Error prefix for a problem in the standard candidate list.

errCustomDescriptions.description: Error prefix for a problem in the custom emoji description list.

busyPickerOpen.description: Reason a background harvest cannot run: the emoji picker is open.

busyDialogOpen.description: Reason a background harvest cannot run: some other dialog is open.

busyTyping.description: Reason a background harvest cannot run: the user is mid-sentence in the composer.

harvestAbortedByUser.message: Stopped because you did something else
harvestAbortedByUser.description: Recorded reason when a background harvest is aborted by user activity.

harvestReadFailed.description: Recorded reason when a background harvest finishes with nothing collected.

popupLoadFailed.message: Could not load. Try reloading the extension.
popupLoadFailed.description: Popup note shown when the initial status request fails.

popupNoWorkspace.message: Open a Slack tab to see that workspace's settings here.
popupNoWorkspace.description: Popup note shown when the active tab is not a supported workspace.

popupPrivacyNote.message: Message text is only sent when you hover over that message, and when you open the emoji picker.
popupPrivacyNote.description: Popup footer note explaining what data leaves the page.

popupWorkspaceEnabled.description: Popup status line when suggestions are enabled for the workspace.

popupWorkspaceDisabled.description: Popup status line when suggestions are disabled for the workspace.

popupToggleAriaLabel.description: Accessible label for the enable/disable switch.

popupEmojiCount.description: Popup line showing how many custom emoji have been learned.

popupUpdatedAt.description: Popup line showing when the custom emoji were last synced.

popupHarvestAgain.description: Button that re-runs the custom-emoji harvest.

popupNoEmojiYet.message: No emoji learned yet. Open the emoji picker once in Slack, and it will quietly collect them after.
popupNoEmojiYet.description: Popup note shown before any custom emoji have been harvested.

popupHarvestNow.description: Button that runs the first custom-emoji harvest.

popupHarvestErrorHint.message: Open the Slack tab and try again.
popupHarvestErrorHint.description: Popup hint shown after a harvest request fails.

popupHarvestFailed.description: Popup message shown when the last recorded harvest failed.

popupDetailsToggle.description: Button that expands the error detail text.

popupKeySaved.description: Popup status shown right after the API key is saved.

popupKeySet.description: Popup status shown when an API key is already configured.

popupChange.description: Link that reopens the API key field to change it.

popupDelete.description: Link that clears the saved API key.

popupKeyEnterNew.description: Popup prompt shown when changing an already-set API key.

popupKeyEnterFirst.message: Enter your API key to get started.
popupKeyEnterFirst.description: Popup prompt shown when no API key is set yet.

popupKeyPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the API key input field.

popupSave.description: Button that saves the entered API key.

popupTimeJustNow.description: Relative time for a moment that just happened.
